svg.aria-label: Falcon's built-in parts and the parts you write
svg.title: Falcon's built-in parts and the parts you write
svg.desc: The falcon.App builds req and resp for each request and calls every part in turn. Built into Falcon: the router, which matches the path to a URI template and picks your resource; media handlers, which parse req.media and render resp.media; and error handlers, which turn exceptions into HTTP error responses. Written by you: middleware, whose process_request and process_response run for every request; hooks, @falcon.before and @falcon.after, which wrap one resource or responder; and responders such as on_get(req, resp) on your resource class.
